verdict.rationale: The only evidence about bulk processing is a community report of a user who built a CrewAI crew that categorizes, labels, drafts replies for, and deletes many emails, so batch-style work over many items is achievable with custom builds. No first-party documentation describes a native bulk or batch operation primitive; Flows and sequential tasks only chain steps rather than fan out across item sets. Missing for 10: documented native batch or bulk-execution API (e.g., running a crew over a list of inputs), first-party docs on parallel processing of many items, and corroboration beyond a single community anecdote.
